Unas hermanas adquieren una misteriosa casona donde suceden cosas extrañas que las hace perder la paciencia y cordura.

Diablo, Jorge y Ángel se ven atrapados en un torbellino de venganza, pasión y resentimiento, donde enfrentarán el peligro supremo por la ambición desmedida de una mujer, mientras que la devoción sincera de otra será su redención.
Ramón recibe en su casa a su amigo Salvador y después llega Rodrigo. Posteriormente, llega Isela y todos se vuelven locos por ella. ¿A quién elegirá?

La historia de un migrante mexicano que busca el sueño americano, pero su camino será pedregoso y lleno de espinas. En su travesía, experimentará duras pruebas y esto provocará una crisis de su fe, cuestionando la existencia de Dios.

El superhombre se desmorona ante sus ojos al enterarse de que aquel que respetaba como a un padre fue quien, en realidad, le arrebató su felicidad al asesinar a su familia entera. La venganza comienza a tomar forma.
El apuesto novio de una joven hermosa desaparece y ella aprende una dura lección.

Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.
Visiones y pesadillas le son reveladas luego de recibir un trasplante de corazón. Un crimen espantoso del pasado ha quedado enterrado y sin castigo.
Cristian es atacado por una entidad maligna, y su madre no sabe qué hacer. Su padrino, el padre Ernesto, luchó para salvarlo y así recuperar la fe del pueblo.

Carolina tiene una vida perfecta: vive en una lujosa casa, trabaja en una revista de moda y está casada con un publicista. Un día, descubre que es estéril, el mismo día que su esposo la deja por su mejor amiga, quien, además, está embarazada de este.
Cuatro amigas de toda la vida que se embarcan en la experiencia de su vida al reunirse para pasar unas vacaciones en Puerto Rico.

Fernando es un diplomático que acaba de conseguir un logro histórico: regresar el penacho de Moctezuma a México. Sin embargo, su suerte cambia cuando su prometida decide dejarlo plantado rumbo al altar.

Rodrigo Sada quiere ser millonario para llevar la vida de lujo y sofisticación que ve en los clientes del restaurante en el que trabaja. Su ambición lo lleva a tomar una ruta fácil para tratar de conseguir lo que quiere.

Ian, un adolescente, descubre que su amado padre no es en realidad su padre biológico, sino que este es André, una antigua estrella de telenovelas que ahora vive alcoholizado y se disfraza de peluche gigante para obtener dinero.

Los Mirreyes y los Godínez se enfrentan nuevamente por una tentadora oferta para la empresa Kuri. Para resolver sus problemas, viajan a un retiro corporativo en donde intentan volver a unirse como equipo.
Un estadounidense descubre que su madre biológica ha muerto y le ha dejado en herencia un restaurante en México.
Dos amigos son confundidos con agentes secretos y enviados a frustrar un plan megalómano que intenta controlar el mundo.

Una rivalidad entre pandillas provoca una tragedia en la década de los sesenta en Oklahoma entre los Soc y los Greasers. Un joven sensible enloquece cuando su mejor amigo mata a un miembro de una pandilla rival.
Con la ayuda de su mejor amigo, un soldado estadounidense que regresó de Afganistán emprende la búsqueda de su esposa y su hijo en un país devastado.
Harper se retira al campo después de una tragedia personal. Las fuerzas oscuras del bosque la acechan.
Un agente retirado de la CIA es secuestrado por terroristas y su hijo descubre que no hay ninguna misión de rescate, entonces él planea solo una operación para traer al padre de vuelta.
Cuatro amigos comparten lo que podría ser su última aventura cuando van en busca del cadáver de un joven desaparecido.
Dos criminales se disfrazan de San Nicolás y como un duende para robar tiendas durante las celebraciones navideñas.

Dos criminales, el malhablado, alcohólico, Willie Soke, y su compañero Marcus, conspiran, con la ayuda de la malhumorada madre de Willie, para estafar a una organización benéfica durante la noche de Navidad.
Charlotte conoce a Kevin, el hombre de sus sueños. Sin embargo, la joven no sabe que su futura suegra, Viola, es un ser diabólico que cree que no hay mujer suficientemente buena para su hijo.

Separadas y decepcionadas con la vida adulta, las Bellas se reúnen de nuevo y están listas para dar la nota, y meter la pata, en una competición europea donde descubren que deberán usar mucho más que sus voces para vencer a sus rivales.
Durante el transcurso de su servicio, Megan y Rex completaron más de 100 misiones hasta que una explosión les hirió, poniendo su destino en peligro.

Cuando el cuartel general de la agencia británica Kingsman es destruido, los espías unen sus fuerzas con una organización aliada estadounidense. Su objetivo es colaborar para intentar derrotar a su enemigo común y salvar al mundo.
Encarcelado por un crimen que no cometió, Divine G encuentra su propósito con un grupo de teatro de hombres privados de la libertad.
La gerente de un banco no se da cuenta de que su nuevo y encantador galán es el mismo hombre que unos días antes la mantuvo secuestrada durante un robo.

Dos jóvenes que predican la fe llaman a la puerta equivocada, la de la casa del diabólico Sr. Reed. Obligadas a participar en un juego mortal, deberán poner a prueba sus creencias para escapar con vida.

Dominika, una antigua bailarina se convierte en agente secreto del servicio ruso, pero la dureza del entrenamiento le pasa factura. Su primera misión le involucra con un agente de la CIA junto al que cae en una espiral de atracción y engaño.

Tommy wants to lose weight so he can marry his fiancée and have the life he always dreamed of with her, but to break the cycle of pathological eating that left him nearly bed-bound, he'll have to face a piece of his past he has always kept secret.
Pauline is 51-years-old and nearly 700 pounds; her addiction to food has taken over the life of her son and primary caretaker.
At 24 years old, Bettie Jo is on her way to reaching 700 pounds and relies on her husband for her basic needs.

Twenty years after her father died as the result of a botched weight-loss surgery, Carrie is on the brink of eating herself to death; she must face the fear and grief of losing her father and end a cycle of toxic behavior with her husband, Chris.

Thederick has become housebound from eating and only goes outside to greet the ice cream man; after a recent hospital scare, it's finally clicked that if Dr. Now's program doesn't work for him, then nothing will.

Cindy is resistant to change and spends years creating a world that makes her feel safe; when her friend notices Cindy's health declining rapidly due to her size, she pushes Cindy to move to Houston and see Dr. Now.

Melissa has isolated herself at home and lost many friends to avoid feeling the shame of what her food addiction has done to her body; now, the only way to get her life back is to leave it behind to start a new one with Dr. Now's help in Houston.
Kenae is already big before her weight gain takes off after the death of her beloved mother; refusing to deal with the pain, Kenae turns to food to fill the void.

Mark sets out with a goal for weight-loss surgery, but as weight loss gets easier, he turns down medical advice and decides to do it on his own; Mark thinks he can lose 500 pounds by himself, but Dr. Now sees this as another excuse not to change.

Brayan se avienta de La Quebrada para obtener el perdón de Toña, pero todo se complica cuando Irmita visita a un Brayan convaleciente.

Montaner ayuda a Brayan a llegar a su cuarto, lo encierra ahí y baja a ayudar a Magali, pero ella se aprovecha para no hacer nada. Paco está con la uróloga, la invita a salir, pero lo rechazan así que llega a su casa muy enojado.

Brayan se emociona por llevar a Magali al concierto del Netón Vega, pero ella lo manda a volar por egoísta. Entre celos y enredos, Brayan termina invitando a Irmita, quien lo rechaza prefiriendo salir con Montaner.

Paco, Lucas y Brayan son desalojados inesperadamente de su departamento tras un extraño proceso legal. Sin otra opción, acaban instalándose como paracaidistas en el pequeño y humilde depa de Betochas, un primo que los recibe a regañadientes.

Magali es la elegida para regresar a trabajar al departamento de Paco, no sin antes poner condiciones tan favorables para ella que harán de su trabajo algo fácil y bien pagado. Lo único que tendrá que enfrentar es la alianza entre Fran y Miranda.

Lucas le chismea a su papá que Brayan amaneció con Leandra Alessandra en el cuarto de la azotea y los cachan encamados. Brayan lo niega, dice que él se ligó a una güera en el bar y no sabe cómo amaneció Leandra ahí, pero ella dice ser su novia.

In 1823, fur trapper Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) treks through the snowy wilderness to track down John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy), a member of his hunting team who killed his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and left him for dead.

After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.
Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

p.d: One fine day, Paddington spots a pop-up book in an antique shop, the perfect present for his beloved aunt's 100th birthday. When a thief steals the prized book, Paddington embarks on a quest to unmask the culprit before her big celebration.

A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.
A polar bear (Rob Schneider) and three mischievous lemmings travel to New York to stop a shady developer (Ken Jeong) from building luxury condos in the Arctic.
A self-styled Lothario (Ryan Gosling) teaches a suddenly single 40-something (Steve Carell) how to be a hit with the ladies.
A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.

A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

Lisa, Hunter and Mitchell learn that their teenage daughters plan to lose their virginity on prom night. The worried parents soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.
As two clans descend on the scene of young twins' birthday, Greg Focker's moonlighting at a pharmaceutical company threatens to derail his position of trust with Jack, his uptight father-in-law.

Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.
When his dad decides it's time for some father-son bonding, Greg Heffley pretends to have a job at a ritzy country club, so his vacation won't be ruined.

Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.
Five highly competitive friends hit the ground running for their yearly, no-holds-barred game of tag -- risking their necks, their jobs and their relationships to take one another down.
Reluctant to dance, the son of Mumble (Elijah Wood) the tap-dancing penguin runs away from home and meets a penguin that can fly.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.
A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.
A leaked clip from Jane's documentary goes viral for all the wrong reasons.
Valerie Cherish is back; Lisa Kudrow stars as the determined former sitcom star trying to stay relevant in a changing industry filled with AI-written shows.
Valerie Cherish stars in a sitcom written by artificial intelligence, which presents her with bizarre challenges.
Valerie finds herself alone amid a media meltdown after news of her AI written show is somehow leaked to the public; Val is further shocked to discover that a member of her team has not signed a NDA.
Valerie tries to repair the damage caused by negative AI press and save Mark's reality show job by making an appearance on "Finance Dudes."
Urged by NuNet to make a public statement in defense of AI, Valerie contemplates her future with or without How's That?!

The shop has a busy week prepping for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas; once in Vegas, Dave and Kev attend the first-ever concours d'elegance at the Wynn hotel and golf course, where their knowledge of cars is pushed to its limits.
As the workshop buzzes with activities, the latest CF1 becomes a new challenge for the team, as Dave makes alterations to the original.
Scottsdale is about to witness one of the fiercest competitions at the last car show of the year; Dave gets all the help he needs with his toolbox.

Off-road vehicles are few and far between at the shop, but when they do arrive, Dave and the guys love to go all out; this particular Hummer gets a huge conversion from two-wheel drive to four-wheel, a new LS engine, interior and a fresh paint job.

The 1955 Nomad is an iconic car, but the original power isn't enough for the current owner, who wants the guys to put a blower on to boost the power; a new project for a secret client arrives in pretty rough shape, but emerges ready to rumble.
A new client, Rick Mezich from "Deadliest Catch," tests Dave's design prowess on his CF1, while the upholstery shop shows off some of the new processes it has developed to streamline the builds.
Influencers taking on Eric Malone from "Fastest Cars in the Dirty South" in grudge races; Freiburger and Finnegan head in reverse by trading a clean duster for a worse car.
The Rubber Duck Firebird goes on a 1,000-mile drag racing road trip.

Freibuger and Dulcich can't pass up buying a '41 Ford former race car that last saw action in some road races back in the late '90s; with tuning, a carburetor rebuild, exhaust modifications and some love, the guys get the Ford back on the open road.

Motorhead Garage visits a shop in Florida to explore their collection and restoration business, meet the people behind it, and learn about the mission that drives their passion for preserving Ford truck history.

Tony and Lucky fastest project ever is the 1,000-horsepower 2006 Chevy Impala SS with an entire second V8 drivetrain crammed into the back, but the front engine needs work, so the guys pull it out and use this chance to upgrade everything.
Lucky Costa gets the chance to decide what to build and chooses a mashup of a 1927 Ford truck body on a mostly 1929 Ford Model T frame, powered by a small-block Chevy.

The C10 short-bed needed a serious power-up; it's time to cram some big power into this killer street truck; Tony and Lucky are stuck on opposite coasts; they aren't going to let that stop them from getting it done.

Tony Angelo scoops up a high-mileage 1999 six-speed manual Corvette for $7,000, and it is begging for upgrades; Lucky Costa tears out the well-used 5.7 liter LS1 engine and upgrades it with a complete top-end kit before taking it down the drag strip.

Willie B and Kevin Byrd double down on Ford's favorite pony car with a Mustang-centric build-off where stock isn't in the vocabulary. The Fox body notchback gets an LS engine swapped in, and the Mustang fastback gets a 7.3 Godzilla swap.
When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.
